title: Digi Filter
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: Per-voice filter modes on the Digitone mk1 / Keys main CPU's voice stage: BP (band pass), BP2 (a wider band pass), COMB and TRASH (two feedback combs), applied to the selected FM voices before the mix. Hooks the render just before the voice mix (0x4009e13e) and filters the chosen voices in place; the stock voices, effects and outputs are untouched. Routing is per voice (the eight voices are shared across the four tracks). The DIGI FILTER master page (via digictl) sets on/off, mode, freq, reso and which voices are filtered.
